title: CEDAR · The glow, explained wrong · I
venue: the novel of the timber country · never past the corner box · Box 14
logline: The first of three explanations, each given by someone sure: a logger says it's the slash pile they never put out in 1994, burning underground still. The page draws the slash pile burning under the ridge like a coal under ash, and the logger's certainty, and doesn't say it's wrong. The next page will.

panels.composition: Tier 1: a logger at a tailgate pointing up at the ridge with a coffee, certain.

image.prompt: a logger at a pickup's tailgate pointing up at a wooded ridge with a coffee in his other hand, wet-on-wet watercolor
